abstract: Sinonasal teratocarcinosarcomas (SNTCSs) are malignant and highly aggressive neoplasms arising in the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses with extension into surrounding structures and intracranial extension in few instances. They are commonly found in males (7-8 times more than in females). They pose difficulty in diagnosis due to their diverse histology. Ideal treatment modalities have not been devised yet due to the rare and highly aggressive nature of SNTCSs as shown in this case report. A 29-year-old Asian male was initially misdiagnosed on biopsy. Surgical debulking was performed initially which showed SNTCSs with radiological evidence of residual disease for which gross tumor clearance was done. He presented within a short span of a month, post re-resection with gross local recurrence. Urgent palliative radiotherapy was planned and started but unfortunately, he developed pulmonary and hepatic metastasis during radiation therapy and was commenced on palliative care only due to significant deterioration of performance status. Treatment of SNTCSs is often delayed due to their difficulty in diagnosis. Its highly aggressive nature prompts an urgent and aggressive treatment approach with adjuvant chemoradiation. Any type of adjuvant therapy is better than surgical resection only given its timely administration and close surveillance.
abstract_ja: 副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫(SNTCSs)は、鼻腔および副鼻腔に発生し、周囲構造への拡張を伴い、稀に頭蓋内への拡張も見られる悪性で高度に攻撃的な腫瘍である。男性に多く見られ(女性より7～8倍)、多様な組織学のため診断が困難である。SNTCSsの稀で高度に攻撃的な性質のため、理想的な治療法はまだ確立されていない。29歳のアジア系男性患者は、生検時に最初に誤診された。初期の腫瘍減量手術が行われ、放射線学的に残存疾患が認められたため、肉眼的腫瘍消失手術が行われた。彼は再切除後1ヶ月以内に肉眼的局所再発で再度来院した。緊急の姑息的放射線療法が計画・開始されたが、残念ながら彼は放射線療法中に肺および肝転移を発症し、著しいパフォーマンスステータスの悪化のため姑息的ケアのみが開始された。SNTCSsの治療は、診断の困難さのため、しばしば遅延される。その高度に攻撃的な性質は、補助化学放射線療法を伴う緊急で攻撃的な治療アプローチを促す。いかなるタイプの補助療法も、その時宜を得た投与とフォローアップを考えると、外科的切除のみより優れている。
